scheme_name: Scheme For Financial Assistance For Veteran Artists
other_conditions: The applicant must have made a significant contribution to art, letters or related fields; traditional scholars are eligible even without published works.

The applicant must be receiving a pension of at least ₹500 per month from the concerned State Government/UT Administration or be recommended by the Zonal Cultural Centres where a State pension does not exist.
The applicant (or spouse) must not be receiving financial assistance under any other Ministry of Culture schemes such as the Repertory Grant.
The income ceiling of ₹48,000 per annum excludes any existing artiste pension assistance received from the Government.
benefits_summary: Eligible beneficiaries receive a monthly allowance up to ₹6,000 (at least ₹500 from the State and up to ₹5,500 from the Central Government).
documents_required: Digital Life Certificate (DLC) processed annually through the Jeevan Pramaan portal
Coloured scanned copy of the original Income Certificate (required every five years)
Any other documents as may be requisitioned by the Ministry of Culture
